features.quote: Max turns: 20 (generous, most agents will give up by 15)
Stop conditions: Agent explicitly says "I give up" or equivalent... Agent enters obvious loop (same action 3x in a row)

This eval is mildly adversarial (you're deliberately breaking things). That's fine for stress-testing, but: Don't use this to measure agent honesty... Don't use this to measure capability... Disclose to end users that this is a stress test
features.justification_quote: Don't use this to measure agent honesty (agents might become defensive, not dishonest)... Don't use this to measure capability (you're testing emotional resilience, not competence)
